**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 04:07
- [USER] The user wants the assistant to act as a search engine optimization expert fluent in English.
- [USER] The user requests the assistant to optimize a blog post about the comparison between dofollow and nofollow links.
- [USER] The user provides original text from a writer for optimization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant agrees to help with optimizing the blog post about dofollow and nofollow links.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provides an optimized version of the original text, including a new introduction and sections on definitions, benefits, and key takeaways regarding dofollow and nofollow links.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant states that dofollow links are also known as “regular” or “natural” links.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explains that dofollow links tell search engine crawlers to follow the link and count it as a vote for the linked page.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explains that nofollow links tell search engine crawlers not to follow them and not to give any credit to the linked page.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant defines dofollow links as HTML attributes that pass along PageRank from one page to another, helping improve rankings in Google's SERPs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant defines nofollow links as HTML attributes that do not pass PageRank and do not bring referral traffic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant notes that dofollow links transfer PageRank, while nofollow links do not, but both can be beneficial for SEO depending on usage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentions that dofollow links tend to draw more organic referral traffic since Google's bots crawl them more frequently.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant states that dofollow links can increase visibility in search engines, improve page authority and rankings, and generate more referral traffic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant lists the benefits of dofollow links, including increased visibility in search engines, improved page authority and rankings, and increased referral traffic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasizes that dofollow links help establish trust between sites by showing a willingness to share information.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explains that having a higher number of dofollow links from authoritative sources can improve overall page authority and ranking within Google's algorithm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant concludes that dofollow and nofollow links are important tools for optimizing online presence and achieving profitability online.
